source: Editorial task: tell residents how to attend the temporary meeting hall. The library hall is available on Tuesday evenings in December only; other meetings remain at the usual hall. Entry is through the side door. The booking office publishes same-day cancellations.

idea.title: Where Tuesday evening meetings take place in December
idea.description: Explain the temporary library hall and side-door entry, with a same-day cancellation check.
idea.rationale: The notice helps residents reach the right room during the temporary arrangement.
idea.evidence: Tuesday evenings in December only; other meetings unchanged.
